title: Prepare the inner word
statement: Let $\mathrm{mode}$ be Boolean, let $h$ be a bit string, and let $zlen$, $ulen$, and $q$ be natural numbers satisfying $2zlen+2\le |h|$, $2ulen+2\le zlen$, and $q\le 2|h|$. Starting with the machine in copy stage $4$ with pointer $4ulen+4$, the second register equal to $|h|$, query register $q$, tail register $2zlen+2$, and all other registers zero, the machine reaches scan stage $2$ with those pointer, query, and tail values changed to zero, $q$, and $2zlen+2$, respectively; the second register remains $|h|$, the retained register becomes $4ulen+4$, and the inner register becomes $4ulen$. The result remains unset, and every intermediate configuration before the final one satisfies the machine's safety condition and has all register values at most $4|h|+4$.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers zlen, ulen, and q
